summary: Market Makers discusses recent IPOs including Fram and Scout Gaming Group, examines overreactions in small caps like Deflamo and Cassandra Oil, and explores high-risk investments in cryptocurrencies and unlisted companies. The hosts recommend watching several companies but emphasize the extreme difficulty of identifying winners and the high failure rate in emerging sectors like crypto.
key_takeaways: Small caps showing extreme price reactions to minor news
IPO market offering interesting cases to watch including Fram and Scout Gaming Group
Cryptocurrency market resembles dotcom bubble with most projects likely to fail
OmiseGo and NEO mentioned as potential alternatives to Ethereum
Frilansfinans is an unlisted opportunity in the gig economy space
Hosts planning dedicated episodes on cryptocurrencies and commodities
